subject: general
question: The term “PSLV-C61/EOS-09,” recently seen in the news, is related to:

options.text: A navigation satellite launched under India’s IRNSS programme.
A reusable launch vehicle developed for human spaceflight missions.
A communication satellite launched for broadband connectivity.
A PSLV mission with a flight-stage anomaly.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISRO stated that recent PSLV missions like PSLV-C61/EOS-09 faced setbacks but are treated as learning opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• PSLV-C61/EOS-09 was a Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle mission that encountered an anomaly during its flight stages. **Hence, Option 4 is correct. **
 
• It is not part of the IRNSS navigation system. **Hence, Option 1 is incorrect. **
 
• It is not a reusable launch vehicle for human spaceflight. **Hence, Option 2 is incorrect. **
 
• It is not a communication satellite mission.** Hence, Option 3 is incorrect. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• PSLV is ISRO’s workhorse launch vehicle.
 
• EOS satellites are Earth observation satellites.
 
• Setbacks help improve reliability of future missions.
